verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a financial platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a full-account export in open formats (such as CSV or JSON bulk export) or an offboarding path. The QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite sync is an adjacent accounting integration, and the APIs are only developer building blocks; neither is a documented open-format export of all data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
